column1: # Synthetic adaptive-learning history representative of a Subaru WRX
# experiencing slow injector drift + IAC valve fouling over ~6 weeks.
# 1 sample per day at noon (epoch seconds). LTFT trends from 0% to
# -4% (injectors getting dirty). DAM stays near 1.0 (no knock). IAC
# adapt slowly rises (idle leak getting worse).
